etapas.texto: On Monday morning, Sam found a big box in front of his door. There was no name on it. Inside, something was moving!
etapas.pergunta: What do you think is in the box?
etapas.explica: Algo estava se mexendo (moving) dentro da caixa: deve ser um animal.

etapas.texto: Sam opened the box slowly. A small brown puppy jumped out and licked his face. There was a note: "Please take care of me. My name is Lucky."
etapas.explica: O bilhete pede "take care of me" (cuide de mim), e Sam parece gostar do cachorro.

etapas.texto: Sam gave Lucky water and food. But in the afternoon, a girl knocked on the door. She was crying. "Have you seen my puppy?" she asked.
etapas.explica: Ela está procurando o cachorrinho: deve ser a dona (owner) dele.

etapas.texto: The girl was Lucky's owner. Her little brother left the puppy at Sam's door as a joke. Sam was sad, but the girl smiled: "You can visit Lucky every day. I live next door!"
